bayts.text: The All-Merciful honoured me with an honour that kept every harm from my whole being; and the grace poured upon me has sufficed.
I addressed my intimate prayer to my Lord in the month of Ramaḍān, the month of security, of wishes granted and of abundance.
I praised Him with a praise that drives Iblīs (Satan) forever towards others than us, driving him away in grief.
The hearts of all the enemies have turned towards what is not harm, and wishes have been turned towards me.
The hearts of all those who have succeeded have turned towards me; and my Lord is the One who sets all things right (Al-Muṣliḥ).
Towards those who once oppressed me the harm meant for me has turned, and likewise the fetters.
From me harm and trial have vanished, by the grace of the Enricher (Allah), who has led sweetness to me.
To Him my thanksgiving, until the Gardens of Paradise, the abode of fulfilled wishes, of security and of favours.
My whole being gives Him thanks through the Book (the Qur'an), without enmity or reproach.
I called upon Him in intimacy, an intimacy full of honour, and He never ceases to be the Bestower of benefit, the Generous.
To Him I have directed my words here, with certainty, and my heart has found peace.
You have helped me, for You are the Helper (An-Naṣīr); You have erased my fault, for You are the All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr).
O Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad), You brought me in Ramaḍān, in overflowing measure, what I had sought from You before it.
In it (Ramaḍān) You returned to me what You love for me, and You warded off from me whatever brings harm.
You answered me with the answer of Him (Allah) who is exalted above all slumber, and You led to me a swift fulfilment.
By Your noble Face bring relief to the believers, and fulfil their hope,
as I invoke blessing and peace upon the Prophet (Muḥammad), bearer of glad tidings to every kinsman and every stranger.
O Protector, grant joy to the Muslims, O You who erased from me harm and affliction.
You erased every affliction that had passed over me, O You who accepted all my services.
Save the Family of the Chosen One (Muḥammad) — after blessing, joined with peace — from their enemies who loathe them.
Through him (the Prophet) make easy for them whatever has become hard, for all that You make easy becomes easy.
Your servant, servant of Your Servant (Khadīm ar-Rasūl), has addressed You in intimate prayer, hoping to obtain his wishes from You.
Those made happy through good have triumphed, and those who knew no happiness have returned laden with harm.
The righteous (Al-Abrār) have been honoured with bliss, and the wicked have been flung headlong into the Blaze.
Those who abandoned worship have been driven towards the fire of Him (Allah) who annihilates whoever does not obey Him.
He has toiled in vain who wished to undo what was firmly established by Him (Allah) with whom the guest suffers no wrong.
The recompense of whoever challenged the Lord of the Throne is weeping, and whomever the Lord of the Footstool (Al-Kursī) makes weep, weeps.
Truly, those who disbelieved and refused to repent have seen the recompense of what they did.
In their bellies scorpions have made their dwelling, and each of them drinks the putrid pus.
For the Muslim men and all the Muslim women is the light of Him (Allah) who made the people of darkness vanish.
They are those who abide forever in the Gardens of Paradise, and in what delights them they are made everlasting.
They have gathered their wishes without anything being taken from them, and all, filled with glad tidings, are transfigured.
Their hope is fulfilled, and for eternity they have been given possession of what no king has ever seen.
Their edifice rises and does not sink; as for him who challenges the Most High (Allah), he is cast down low.
Believe in God and submit all together, and do good for the Face of the Everlasting (Allah), who has subdued (every tyrant).
He is the Divinity, He is the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), He is the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), and to Him belong the ages.
From me to Him the most fruitful praise and the most grateful thanks, in service of the Chosen One (Muḥammad), the thankful servant.
I have renounced a great part of what is permitted, for the sake of Him (Allah) who sufficed me against those who bark (the slanderers).
I give Him thanks: He has led to me the Substitutes (Al-Abdāl), just as He sufficed me against war and dispute.
Glory be to Him! He is the Generous (Al-Karīm), the Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd); and whoever does not love me is consumed by grief.
May the peace of Him (Allah) who turns no harm against me be upon him (Muḥammad) through whom I have been kept from deception.
The recompense of Him (Allah) who is exalted above all likeness has led to me what is hidden from my peers.
Praise be to God, without end, for the son of ʿAbd Allāh (Muḥammad), the one clothed in splendour.
The excellence of the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad) is not hidden, save from him from whom, as a punishment, it is veiled.
To the Chosen One (Muḥammad) I have devoted that which turned Iblīs (Satan) away towards others than us, and he has departed.
I struck down falsehood with truth, and it vanished; and for me my God has filled to the brim, like an overflowing cup, His giving of drink.
I have given over, O Lord, to my Sovereign the whole of my being: my state is for Him, as are my work and my intention.
By God and by the Messenger (Muḥammad) I have repelled those who opposed the Truth, and I have obtained what I asked.
The Divinity (Allah) has made me free of association and of all hypocrisy, and has guaranteed my felicity.
He has made me free of my soul's fault through the Prophet (Muḥammad), upon whom He sends blessing with overflowing peace.
